description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) issues this Sources Sought announcement to conduct market research on behalf of the Egyptian Navy and identify parties with the resources to procure various spare parts for Schneider (Shorebox) Systems, Static Frequency Converters (FCX), and other miscellaneous components. As a result of this market research, the U.S. Government will gain a better understanding of industry capabilities for this potential future requirement, which is anticipated to be solicited on a Full and Open basis. Interested parties who consider themselves qualified are invited to submit a Statement of Capabilities in response to this notice. Submissions must be emailed no later than 10:00 AM EST on March 13, 2026, to both Contract Specialist Mikayla Shanholtzer at Mikayla.B.Shanholtzer@usace.army.mil and Contracting Officer Peter Smith at Peter.S.Smith@usace.army.mil. The email subject line should read: [Your Company Name] ? Response to Sources Sought W912ER26RA021. This is not a solicitation, and no contract will be awarded from this announcement. Submission of any information is purely voluntary, and the Government assumes no financial responsibility for any costs incurred. Do not submit classified material.
